t: Powerful, cast aluminium Titan TTB521GRB 200mm electric bench grinder and polisher is built for controlled grinding, sharpening and cleaning of metal tools. Powered by a 400W brushless induction motor for steady performance with low maintenance and reduced wear. Suitable for use in workshops, garages and site benches, for sharpening tools such as chisels, plane irons and drill bits, as well as for rust removal and deburring. Includes an LED work light, adjustable tool rests and eye shields to support accurate work, and dust-sealed bearings to help extend service life in trade environments.
b: Suitable For Sharpening, Deburring & Rust Removal
